Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 33664 of 2023

Applicant :- Muaz Ahmad
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Shahroze Khan,Mohammad Zafar Yab Khan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Jhamman Ram, learned AGA-I, for the State, apprised the Court that notice has been served to the informant of the case on 21.6.2023.
2.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.
3. Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

4. Heard Sri Shahroze Khan, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamman Ram, learned AGA-I, for the State.
5.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.25 of 2023, under Sections 376-D and 506 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Kathela Samay Mata, District Siddharth Nagar during pendency of the trial.

sentences.text:
6. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and two others and according to the FIR,
applicant and his two associates committed gang rape with the maternal grand-daughter of the informant aged about 15 years.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation of rape made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and although during investigation prosecutrix, i.e., victim of the case stated against the applicant but when she appeared before the trial court as PW-1 on 5.8.2023 then she specifically stated that applicant did not commit rape with her and she even did not state that rape was committed with her and stated that due to fear she became unconscious.
8.
He further submits that as prosecutrix during trial did not support the prosecution case and has declared hostile therefore, no evidence left against the applicant.
9. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 9.4.2023.

10. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayerfor bail and submits that victim is hardly 15 years old girl and in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. during investigation she stated against the applicant and other accused persons but learned AGA could not dispute the fact that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and is in jail since April, 2023 and victim of the case, i.e., prosecutrix when appeared before trial court as PW-1 then she did not even state before trial court that rape was committed with her and she categorically stated that applicant did not commit rape with her.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. Although, as per allegation made in the FIR and in the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. during investigation, applicant committed rape with the prosecutrix along with two others and as per prosecution prosecutrix was about 15 years old but when the prosecutrix appeared before the trial court as PW-1 on 5.8.2023 then she did not support the prosecution case and was declared hostile and from her statement recorded before the trial court which has been annexed along with the supplementary affidavit it appears that she did not even state that rape was committed with her and she categorically stated that applicant did not commit rape with her.
13.
Further, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since April, 2023.

14. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

sentences.text:
Let the applicant-Muaz Ahmad be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
